title: Babies are born with around 270 bones, but adults have about 206
body: A newborn’s skeleton contains many separate bony pieces, linked by cartilage and flexible tissue, that gradually fuse as the child grows. The skull starts as several plates joined by soft seams, which helps the head pass through the birth canal and leaves room for the brain to expand. Other bones fuse too, such as the five vertebrae that merge into the sacrum at the base of the spine, leaving the familiar adult count of about 206.

slides.question: Why does a newborn’s skull start as separate plates joined by soft seams?
options: To squeeze through the birth canal
Bone only starts forming after birth
slides.explanation: The seams let the head pass through the birth canal and leave room for the brain to expand before the plates fuse.
